config.route:
- route:
    from:
      uri: direct:partner-npsb
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=ISO.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/npsb/v1/transfers&auth=none"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=ISO.response&definiteStatuses=400"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'STATUS_QUERY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=ISO.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/npsb/v1/status&auth=none"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=ISO.response&definiteStatuses=400,404"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'REVERSE'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=ISO.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/npsb/v1/returns&auth=none"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=ISO.response&definiteStatuses=400"
        - to: "kamelet:mw-audit"
